Corrections applied and committed.

Commit: `a365c98 Qualify paired comparisons by source and spec provenance` — exactly 3 files (`tools/conditions.ts`, `tools/conditions.test.ts`, `campaign/provenance-report.md`); no startup/config/log files.

Corrections
- Malformed present identity now rejected for every field: non-string (`typeof`), empty, and whitespace-only (`v.trim() === ''`). Only `undefined`/`null` counts as legacy/absent. Arbitrary nonempty strings pass; no hash-format check. See `identifyArm` tools/conditions.ts:132.
- Fixture made coherent: `pairRec` FEN now 8 ranks `a6k/8/8/8/8/8/8/A5AK` with White `stats.start` `A:2` (tool: conditions.test.ts:265).
- Report counts corrected to baseline 14, new 17, total 31; added a supervision-corrections section.

Evidence
- `npx tsx tools/conditions.ts --pair .tmp-prov/badA.jsonl,.tmp-prov/goodB.jsonl` → `Error: ... has a blank src value; an identity field must be a non-empty string or genuinely absent`, exit 2.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0.
- `npx vitest run tools/conditions.test.ts` → `Tests 31 passed (31)`, exit 0.
- `git diff --check` → exit 0.
- New regressions cover non-string/empty/whitespace-only per field (unit + CLI), `null` as legacy, mixed/partial, different source, differing spec/rules with review, legacy and one-side-missing UNVERIFIED.

Temp fixtures removed. AGENTS.md/LESSONS.md/TASKS.md (supervisor context) left uncommitted, untouched.
